decisive_items: Revealed perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates around cystically dilated follicular infundibula
Alcian blue staining showed focal mild follicular mucin deposition
CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
response.rationale: Folliculocentric atypical CD4+ infiltrate with follicular mucin deposition and high follicular CD4:CD8 ratio is diagnostic of folliculotropic mycosis fungoides; generic MF/CTCL diagnoses omit the decisive folliculotropic pattern.

rejected.why: Too broad; cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is the category but not the specific folliculotropic variant supported by the histologic and IHC findings.
Mycosis fungoides is plausible and closely related, but the perifollicular infiltrates and follicular mucin deposition specifically indicate the folliculotropic subtype.
